zh-CN.title: 曲阜
zh-CN.subtitle: 孔子出生地与儒家记忆的城市入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 曲阜把孔子的出生地、鲁国历史空间与后世孔氏遗产景观连接起来，是进入儒家人物—地点关系的关键城市。
curatorialDescription: 地图上的曲阜使用城市尺度坐标，表达孔子出生地与后世遗产景观的对应关系；孔庙、孔林和孔府的现存建筑年代不被倒写成孔子时代的现场。
曲阜与孔子的关系属于出生地语境，和他后来的教学、周游及儒家经典接受保持不同层次。
zh-CN.researchNote: UNESCO 世界遗产条目将曲阜作为孔子出生地及孔氏遗产景观登记；本馆以城市级近似坐标呈现，具体出生地、遗产建筑分期与史传文本仍需分别核对。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 孔子生平出生地语境（约公元前 551–479 年）；后世遗产景观延续

en.title: Qufu
en.subtitle: The city entry for Confucius's birthplace and Confucian memory
en.shortSummary: Qufu connects Confucius's birthplace, the historical space of Lu and the later Kong-family heritage landscape as a key city in the person–place model.
curatorialDescription: The map uses a city-scale coordinate for Qufu's correspondence with Confucius's birthplace and later heritage landscape; the surviving Temple, Cemetery and Mansion are not projected back as a literal scene from his lifetime.
Qufu's link to Confucius is a birthplace context, distinct from his later teaching, travels and the reception of Confucian classics.
en.researchNote: The UNESCO World Heritage entry registers Qufu as the birthplace of Confucius and the later Kong-family heritage landscape. This museum uses an approximate city-scale point while keeping the precise birthplace, architectural phases and historiographical passages separate.
en.timeLabel: Birthplace context for Confucius (c. 551–479 BCE); later heritage landscape continues

zh-CN.title: 蓝毗尼
zh-CN.subtitle: 佛陀诞生传统与佛教遗产地理的入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 蓝毗尼把释迦牟尼的出生传统、考古遗产与后世朝圣地理连接起来，补足佛教人物地图的起点。
curatorialDescription: 蓝毗尼的现实坐标指向遗产地点；释迦牟尼诞生于此属于佛教传统与遗产记忆共同保存的层次，不被写成可以逐字复原的同时代出生记录。
从蓝毗尼到鹿野苑，地图让人物、教法与朝圣空间形成可切换的路线入口；传统叙事与考古遗存仍保持分层。
zh-CN.researchNote: UNESCO 将蓝毗尼登记为佛陀诞生地，并记录考古遗产层。本馆使用遗产地点的近似坐标，传统年代、出生叙事与建筑分期不互相替代。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 佛陀诞生传统与蓝毗尼遗产层；传统年代有争议

en.title: Lumbini
en.subtitle: An entry into Buddha-birth tradition and Buddhist heritage geography
en.shortSummary: Lumbini connects the birth tradition of Śākyamuni, archaeological heritage and later pilgrimage geography, adding a point of origin to the Buddhist figure map.
curatorialDescription: The real coordinate points to the heritage site. The tradition that Śākyamuni was born here is preserved through Buddhist memory and heritage records, not presented as a recoverable verbatim birth record from the same period.
From Lumbini to Sarnath, the map makes person, teaching and pilgrimage space switchable while keeping traditional narrative and archaeological remains distinct.
en.researchNote: UNESCO registers Lumbini as the birthplace of the Buddha and records its archaeological heritage layer. This museum uses an approximate heritage-site coordinate while keeping traditional dating, birth narrative and architectural phases separate.
en.timeLabel: Buddha-birth tradition and Lumbini heritage layer; traditional dates contested
